_README: The agent registry, read by /usr/libexec/almanac-agentbox on the host and
shipped unchanged into the guest image so the two cannot disagree.
command    the executable to run inside the microVM
package    the npm package that provides it
token_vars environment variables forwarded into the guest BY NAME if
they are set on the host. Never NAME=value: the value would
land in the wrapper's argv and from there in ps output.
credential how `agentbox login` obtains and stores a token:
env     the variable the stored token is presented as
obtain  a command that PRINTS a token, or null if the
token has to be fetched from a web console
note    what to tell the operator
cpus       vCPUs for this agent's VM
ram_mib    memory for this agent's VM, committed up front at boot
built      whether agent_image/Containerfile actually installs it.
This mirrors the WITH_<AGENT> build arg defaults and has to
be changed in the same commit that changes them.
cpus/ram_mib here are the wrapper's defaults carried forward, NOT measured
figures. Phase 2 item 5 produces the real numbers per agent; until someone
records them, every agent gets the same conservative allocation.

credential.note: Prints a long-lived OAuth token meant for headless use. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set in your shell takes precedence over anything stored here.

opencode's own `auth login` writes a credential file rather than printing a token, and that file would have to be mounted into the guest to be useful. Paste a provider API key instead: every provider opencode supports accepts one by environment variable.
